examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The four outcomes at the medium size: a check for success, a cross for danger, an exclamation for warning and a dash for neutral, each named by the locale catalog.

examples.name: Sizes
examples.summary: Small (16 px) for rows and checklists, medium (20 px) beside a label, large (48 px) at the head of an outcome screen.

examples.name: Animated
examples.summary: `animated` scales the disc in and draws the glyph when the mark appears and every time its severity changes; under reduced motion it shows at once. Here a deploy finishes and the mark turns from neutral to success or danger.
